messages:
josh_acme: Hi team — starting ~09:10 UTC we're seeing ~25-30% 5xxs on POST /v1/generate in ap-southeast1. No changes on our side. Examples: x-request-id=acme-req-7192 -> 503, x-request-id=acme-req-7193 -> 200. Can you advise?

sasha: Sorry to hear that, looping eng-oncall. Are you on the official SDK and which version? Any chance you can paste one failing x-request-id?

josh_acme: Using SDK js v0.14.1. Failing id: acme-req-7192. Payload is a ~6k token prompt (long chat history). We see retries from our side (default backoff) but still getting 503s intermittently.

ingress-bot: deploy-bot: traffic rollout to runtime-v2 started at 2026-04-03T09:05:12Z (canary -> 10%).

marta: thanks @sasha — looking at ingress for ap-southeast1. I see a cluster of upstream 502/503s from runtime-v2 around 09:08-09:12. Root cause not obvious yet.

ryan: quick snapshot from the runtime logs for acme-req-7192: 
```
[2026-04-03T09:10:04Z] request=acme-req-7192 upstream=runtime-v2 instance=i-09abc status=500 kernel_error=kv_cache_alloc_fail prompt_tokens=6150
```
Seems like a KV cache allocation failure for long prompts on the new kernel path. Might be a regression in the kernel selection logic for >4k sequences.

sasha: can we try pinning ACME to runtime-v1 (stable) as a mitigation? Also @josh_acme, can you confirm if failures stop if you shorten prompt?

josh_acme: short test: trimmed prompt to ~3k tokens, same request id pattern -> 200 consistently. Pinning would be great — production traffic is critical.

marta: rolling a route fallback now to pin tenant acme-corp -> runtime-v1, will update once done.

ingress-bot: router-update: route acme-corp -> runtime-v1 applied at 2026-04-03T09:18:47Z

sasha: @josh_acme can you confirm after the route change?

josh_acme: Confirmed: we've sent 20 requests over the last 2 mins, 0 failures, p95 latency back to baseline. Thanks. :tada:

ryan: created INC-2026-123 (runtime-v2-kvcache-fail) and assigned to eng-runtime. Repro steps: long prompt >4k tokens + runtime-v2 kernel-selection -> kv cache blow.

marta: we'll run the runtime-v2 canary tests with synthetic long prompts and push a hotfix; ETA for fix 3-6 hours.

sasha: We'll keep ACME pinned until the fix is validated. I'll follow up with customer postmortem and rollback rationale.

josh_acme: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please share any ETA/comments in this thread so our oncall can plan.

ryan: noted — will post progress updates here. For transparency: temporary mitigation = routing pin, no billing changes.

sasha: Next steps: eng-runtime tries hotfix -> internal canary -> unpin if green. Posting this thread to support ticket for record. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks all — tagging for postmortem: @ryan @sasha.
